resources.string:
Voice Commands:
 • "Open [app name]" - Launch an app
 • "Call [number]" - Make a phone call
 • "WhatsApp [contact] [message]" - Send WhatsApp message
 • "Message [contact] [message]" - Send WhatsApp message
 • "Search [query]" - Search on Google
 • "Google [query]" - Search on Google
 • "Look up [query]" - Search on Google
